summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a proposal to segment data into three distinct zones for separate recalculations. This idea, suggested by someone (Esben), was reviewed for potential side effects and implementation complexity.

It was agreed that the proposed approach involves separating facilities/frames across different zones. The conversation concluded with scheduling logistics regarding an upcoming meeting where access restrictions for new freelancers were discussed.
decisions: Segmenting data into three zones for separate recalculation is a viable idea.
action_items: Review potential side effects of segmenting data and implementing the separation of facilities/frames across different zones.
